feed.title: The Ringshadow blog
feed.subtitle: How Ringshadow is being built, as it happens.

entry.title: Through the walls: walking between regions
entry.summary: Each region now has a ground of its own, cliff walls and passages, and walking from one region into the next happens without a reload or a jump.

entry.title: The world map: the real ground, seen from above
entry.summary: Press M for a picture of every region you've been to, its real ground seen from above, with pilots, mercenaries, the Brood, buildings and deposits live on it and a tooltip on each.

entry.title: The Matriarch wakes in Slag Pockets
entry.summary: The Brood's queen now lives at her nest in Slag Pockets: 6,000 hp, a slam, an acid spit and a roar that rallies her horde. Pilots who fell her share 3,000 ore, 1,500 MH and a rare blueprint.

entry.title: Guns for the realm: the Citadel shoots back
entry.summary: Four corner turrets on every Citadel, a Sentinel AA tower and a gatling gun firing red-hot ore-and-MH rounds, and upgrades on every turret paid from your own wallet.

entry.title: Mercenaries: they mine while you sleep
entry.summary: Hire mercenary prospectors at the Citadel: in a world day each one mines what you mine in an hour, and they keep working while the game is closed.

entry.title: The world runs on after you quit
entry.summary: Quit the game and the world keeps going: the local server stays up, the clock turns, meteors fall and the Brood roams, at about 0.008% of a CPU core.

entry.title: Coming next: guns for the realm, and a canyon to hold
entry.summary: Coming, not in the game yet: the Citadel's guns, an AA tower, a gatling gun firing red-hot ore-and-MH rounds, and a canyon the pilots defend wave by wave.

entry.title: The Brood: from a painting to the world in a day
entry.summary: The first enemies: four alien bugs, from concept paintings to blockout models to the world, where they linger at deposits, bite, dive, eat ore and raid buildings.

entry.title: Missions, the Journal and three voices
entry.summary: The Citadel offers missions in three tiers, a Journal keeps them, and three narrators read every briefing.

entry.title: The realm: shared buildings, a tax and a shop
entry.summary: Every building now belongs to every pilot. The Citadel takes 10% of each unload into a realm wallet and sells blueprints and supplies.

entry.title: How we got here
entry.summary: Two days, seven milestones of the MMORPG mode: our own server, a world that lasts, a hundred levels, the ringshadow sweep and starfall.
